decisions.decision: Shard descriptions by FIXED record count (SHARD_SIZE=20,000) — not by repository_code
decisions.rationale: Per-repo sharding works on current corpus (max shard 302 MB) but is data-dependent; fixed-count shards are bounded by design regardless of repo distribution

decisions.decision: Use entity-index.json/place-index.json for _linked_count instead of reading 84K shard files
decisions.rationale: Matches existing Eleventy loader logic; single file read vs ~84,000 I/Os per run
package.json has no "type": "module"; coexists cleanly with precompute-links.js and the still-present src/_data/*.js loaders. Vitest bridges CJS→ESM for test imports
V8's 512 MiB max string length means JSON.stringify on the full descriptions array throws RangeError; stream record-by-record instead
